svg.title: Every B. subtilis OD600 run on BR-01, June to October 2026
svg.desc: Six panels. Run 1 and run 2: hand-sampled OD600 in the bioreactor against a shake flask. Run 3: 434 hours of in-line OD600 at 22 °C. Run 4: in-line OD600 in two logged parts with a 10-hour gap. Run 5: the reading breaks down after ten hours. Run 6: 42 hours of continuous in-line OD600.
svg.text: Hand-sampled; stopped by a leak at the pump
In-line photometer, no sample drawn, 434 h
Run 4 · 1 to 6 September, 168 + constitutive ACCD, full module
In-line photometer, two logged files, 10 h unrecorded
Run 5 · 8 to 10 October, WB800 + constitutive ACCD, 72 LMH
In-line photometer, four logged files, bubbles in the flow cell
Run 6 · 14 to 16 October, WB800 + constitutive ACCD, 36 LMH
In-line photometer with the acceptance gate, 42 h continuous

Lines: medians of the in-line reading (hourly in runs 3 and 4, half-hourly in run 5, quarter-hourly in run 6). Panels have their own axes; runs 1 and 2 are hand samples. Grey: readings the twin does not use.
